Sentence (English): My previous dishwasher had reached the end of its life, so I looked for a replacement and chose this one because it was affordable.
Comments (English): [ The Evolution of the Dishwasher Auntie ] || ---------------- || My previous dishwasher had reached the end of its life, so I looked for a replacement and chose this one because it was affordable. However, I was very satisfied with the value for money. First of all, the installation technician was the epitome of kindness. It seemed like they receive extensive service training. Their customer service and professionalism were top-notch. Because someone like that installed it, I quickly became friendly with the unfamiliar "dishwasher lady." The new dishwasher is the same size, but it holds a lot more dishes. It accommodates large dishes, and even pots fit inside. There is nothing that doesn't fit. The cutlery holder has also gotten bigger. I believe this is the result of the researchers' hard work in thoroughly studying the internal structure to accommodate large and small dishes, even though the size remains the same. So now, I hardly ever wash dishes by hand. If I wonder if something will fit, it all does. And the cleanliness after washing makes me feel absolutely great. I tend to use home appliances for a ridiculously long time. What I realized this time is that appliances should be replaced with new ones every five years. This is because their functions and performance are constantly evolving. I am extremely satisfied. LG is great!

Sentence (English): Let me put it this way – this Bosch SMV4HVX03E is a classic example of a dishwasher that might not make a "wow" impression on paper, but in everyday life, it simply gets the job done and doesn't annoy anyone.
Comments (English): [ Bosch - the best choice. ] || ---------------- || Let me put it this way – this Bosch SMV4HVX03E is a classic example of a dishwasher that might not make a "wow" impression on paper, but in everyday life, it simply gets the job done and doesn't annoy anyone. The first thing I noticed after a few days was how quiet it is. Seriously, sometimes you have to go over and check if it's even running. At ~46 dB, it's really not annoying, even if you have an open-plan kitchen. As for cleaning – it's very good. You don't have to fiddle with anything or do it by hand. Even if you throw in dried-on items like a pan or dinner plates, it handles everything without a problem. This is the kind of dishwasher where you just throw in the dishes and have peace of mind – without wondering if it's "really going to clean." A big plus for the capacity. Those 14 place settings aren't just a theory – you can really fill it with a lot without having to run it every day. It also organizes dishes well, the baskets are well-made, and you don't have to struggle to fit anything in. Controlling them via your phone is also a nice feature. At first, it seems unnecessary, but in practice, it can be useful – you can turn the dishwasher on from the couch or check how much is left. The extra drying function is also a plus – it actually works better than in cheaper models. Plastic items, which are usually wet, often come out almost dry. But let's not be perfect – there are also downsides. The biggest is the energy rating of D, so it's not the most energy-efficient dishwasher on the market. The second thing is the lack of automatic door opening after washing. In more expensive models, this is standard and makes a difference when drying, whereas here you sometimes have to open the door manually. In summary, this is a very "safe" choice. It's not for someone looking for frills and a wow factor, but if you want a dishwasher that: cleans well, is quiet, has a large capacity, and simply runs smoothly, it's hard to find fault with it. The kind of appliance you simply stop thinking about because it does its job. #opiniamotivowanapromocą
Comments (Original): [ Bosch-najlepszy wybór. ] || ---------------- || Powiem tak – ta Bosch SMV4HVX03E to typowy przykład sprzętu, który może nie robi efektu „wow” na papierze, ale w codziennym życiu po prostu robi robotę i nie wkurza.Pierwsze, co zauważyłem po kilku dniach, to jak cicho działa. Serio, czasami trzeba podejść i sprawdzić, czy ona w ogóle pracuje. Przy tych ~46 dB naprawdę nie przeszkadza, nawet jak masz kuchnię otwartą na salon.Jeśli chodzi o mycie – tutaj jest bardzo dobrze. Nie trzeba nic kombinować ani domywać ręcznie. Nawet jak wrzucisz zaschnięte rzeczy typu patelnia czy talerze po obiedzie, to ogarnia bez problemu. To jest właśnie taki poziom, gdzie wrzucasz naczynia i masz spokój – bez zastanawiania się, czy „na pewno domyje”.Duży plus za pojemność. Te 14 kompletów to nie jest teoria – naprawdę można sporo napchać i nie trzeba jej odpalać codziennie. Dobrze się też układa naczynia, kosze są sensownie zrobione i nie trzeba się siłować, żeby coś zmieścić.Fajna sprawa to też sterowanie przez telefon. Na początku wydaje się zbędne, ale w praktyce bywa przydatne – możesz włączyć zmywarkę z kanapy albo sprawdzić, ile jeszcze zostało do końca.Na plus też funkcja dodatkowego suszenia – faktycznie działa lepiej niż w tańszych modelach. Plastikowe rzeczy, które zwykle są mokre, tutaj często wychodzą już prawie suche.Ale żeby nie było idealnie – są też minusy.Największy to klasa energetyczna D, więc nie jest to najbardziej oszczędna zmywarka na rynku.Druga rzecz – brak automatycznego otwierania drzwi po myciu. W droższych modelach to już standard i robi różnicę przy suszeniu, a tutaj trzeba czasem uchylić ręcznie.Podsumowując – to jest bardzo „bezpieczny” wybór.Nie jest to sprzęt dla kogoś, kto szuka bajerów i efektu wow, ale jeśli chcesz zmywarkę, która:dobrze myjejest cichajest pojemnai po prostu działa bez problemówto ciężko się do niej przyczepić. Taki sprzęt, o którym po prostu przestajesz myśleć, bo robi swoje. #opiniamotywowanapromocją

Recently purchased the new one and although it cleans very well the wheels on the bottom rack are very hard to maneuver. We did some research on this and found other people had complained and Bosch will replace them with wider wheels at no charge. We did call and after being on hold for 90 minutes were told they would replace them but they were back ordered and they couldn't give us a time line for receiving them. My question is obviously this is a design flaw and why are they still making the dishwasher this way? I'm afraid I'm going to hurt my back trying to wheel the bottom rack in.

Sentence (English): There was a very strong toxic smell coming what I thought was the washing machine, however, I figured out the smell was coming from the black rubber hose that the Homedepot installer put under the sink for the draining process.
Comments (English): There was a very strong toxic smell coming what I thought was the washing machine, however, I figured out the smell was coming from the black rubber hose that the Homedepot installer put under the sink for the draining process. He cut the original drainage hose & put a black rubber hose as an extention to reach the opposite side of the sink with the garbage disposal. He didn't ask permission to do so, & we were told by the second team that came out a few days ago to remove the toxic smelling hose, that he was supposed to do that modification only if we requested it. So the 1st team left us with a smelly kitchen which gave us headaches for over 5 months until we couldn't stand it anylonger. Fortunately the second team was able to get rid of most of the toxic rubber hose & attach the original cut hose directly to the drainage location. The machine is fine, & we are glad that the horrible smell which we originally thought was coming from the machine, is now gone. Hopefully that installer will not do this to any more customers!

He didn't ask permission to do so, & we were told by the second team that came out a few days ago to remove the toxic smelling hose, that he was supposed to do that modification only if we requested it. So the 1st team left us with a smelly kitchen which gave us headaches for over 5 months until we couldn't stand it anylonger. Fortunately the second team was able to get rid of most of the toxic rubber hose & attach the original cut hose directly to the drainage location. The machine is fine, & we are glad that the horrible smell which we originally thought was coming from the machine, is now gone. Hopefully that installer will not do this to any more customers!

It's extremely quiet; you literally forget it's running, which is a huge plus at home. It's a far cry from my old dishwasher, which sounded like a sports bar on a Saturday night. If you want something reliable, efficient, and quiet, this is an excellent choice.

Sentence (English): I recently had a Samsung built-in dishwasher installed and have been using it, and overall, I am quite satisfied.
Comments (English): [ It's the best. ] || ---------------- || I recently had a Samsung built-in dishwasher installed and have been using it, and overall, I am quite satisfied. First of all, the clean design makes the kitchen feel much more organized. Since it is a built-in unit, the exterior doesn't stand out and blends in naturally, just like a cabinet, which I liked the most. It takes up minimal space, so it seems to fit well even in small kitchens. The interior is more spacious than I expected, allowing me to organize dishes, cups, and pots all at once, and the shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to arrange dishes. The ability to load items vertically is particularly practical. The cleaning power is also quite good. Even greasy dishes come out clean, and drying seems to work reasonably well. The noise isn't loud, so it isn't too bothersome even when running it at night. The only downside is that the detergent dispenser location and course selection might be a bit confusing the first time you use it, but you get used to it quickly after using it a few times.

Comments (English): [ Not worth the stress ] || ---------------- || I bought an open box excellent condition in the 400 series and called to verify the item. Looked at the tag on the inside but was labeled incorrectly as a 400 series. I figured customer service would help but ultimately found out they need more training and a sense of empathy. I had one guy tell me that I had to drive back to the store and offered 75$ for the inconvenience but couldn't tell me if the unit I purchased was available. Then had another guy say he could only offer me 25$ for the inconvenience but I had to have an active order to receive it not just return the item. Opted in the possible fixing the unit which I kept getting transferred to kitchenaid warranty which the unit wasn't covered under them for the amount of dents it had. Finally got geek squad out and said it's damaged and have to return it. Save yourself the headache and go through kitchenaid. And to best buy: train your people!

Comments (English): [ The Quietist Dishwasher in Our Kitchen! ] || ---------------- || Our LG Dishwasher started screaming. It was like a banchi was being pummeled inside that thing. Our appliance guy was called in to fix it. He said. "forget this one. Get a Bosch 500. The price is fine, it will last more than 6 years and you won't know it is running unless you look at the floor." He was right! We thought the LG was quiet. Ha! The Bosch noise level is speechless. It was easy to install because we had our Appliance person install it. The dishes come out cleaner than the LG ever cleaned. This thing is almost perfect. Almost perfect. I wish the silverware holder was bigger. We throw parties and utensils abound during those. The racks don't hold nearly as many dishes, cups, wine glasses as the LG. I'm predicting we will have to do two loads for every LG load. The significant other says, "We will struggle through and simply focus on how clean the dishes. Think of all the extra hours of sleep we are getting! " All in all, I'd recommend the Bosch 500. You won't know it is running unless you look for the red light on the floor.

Sentence (English): [This review was collected as part of a promotion.]
Comments (English): [ Quiet dishwasher ] || ---------------- || [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This dishwasher has several advantages: a stainless steel tub, an easy-to-clean filter, quiet operation, etc. However, the rinse aid reservoir is shallow and difficult to fill because air bubbles are always trapped and struggle to escape. The control panel buttons behave strangely when activated, as they don't always respond or require only a light touch. Some dishwashers have a small vent that opens to release heat at the end of the cycle. This one doesn't, and as a result, when you open the dishwasher later, you get a strong smell of soap and/or rinse aid. In short, it's an excellent dishwasher that could be improved.
Comments (Original): [ Lave-vaisselle silencieux ] || ---------------- || [Cet avis a été recueilli dans le cadre d’une promotion.] Ce lave-vaisselle possède plusieurs atouts: cuve en acier inoxydable, filtre facile à nettoyer, fonctionnement silencieux, etc. D'autre part, le réservoir du liquide 'Rinse' est peu profond et difficile à remplir car il y a toujours des bulles d'air qui ont de la difficulté à s'échapper. Les touches du panneau de contrôle se comportent bizarrement lors de l'activation car les boutons ne répondent pas toujours ou bien il faut surtout simplement les effleurer. Certains lave-vaisselles ont une petite ouverture s'ouvrant pour laisser échapper la chaleur à la fin du cycle. Celui-ci n'en possède pas et de ce fait lorsqu'on ouvre le lave-vaisselle plus tard, on sent une forte odeur de savon et/ou du liquide 'Rinse'. En bref, c'est un excellent lave-vaisselle qui pourrait être amélioré.

Sentence (English): Motivation for Purchase: I purchased the LG DIOS Objet dishwasher as a housewarming gift for my sister.
Comments (English): Motivation for Purchase: I purchased the LG DIOS Objet dishwasher as a housewarming gift for my sister. I wanted to give her an appliance that improves her quality of life while reducing housework; since I use the same product myself, I felt that a dishwasher would be the most practical choice. Color Selection: My home is 25 pyeong (approx. 82 sq ft), so my kitchen is white-toned and I use beige. However, my sister's kitchen is generally dark brown, so I agonized over the color choice. The 'Nature Manhattan Midnight' color immediately caught my eye. Seeing it installed, I felt I made the right choice. It blends naturally with the kitchen furniture colors without standing out too much, and it acts as a sophisticated accent, so I am completely satisfied! User Review: It creates a much warmer and more sophisticated atmosphere than typical white or stainless steel products, so I am very satisfied with the interior design. My sister loved it so much that she said it was a perfect fit for our home as soon as she saw it. She says she is also quite satisfied with the functional aspects after using it. She says it is much more convenient than hand washing because it cleanly handles a large amount of dishes in one go and dries them cleanly without water stains. She says it is especially useful on busy days or after guests have visited. I also liked that the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't too bothersome even when running it in the evening. I recommend the size. Actually, my sister used a dishwasher in her previous home as well. Since she is a family of four, she initially bought a 10-place setting or 8-place setting model thinking it would be sufficient, but she said she felt it was too small after actually using it. I am a family of three and have been using a 14-place setting model, and I even left a review saying that the 14-place setting is definitely the answer! Of course, it might be a large size for a household of just two adults who don't cook often, but since appliances are used for a long time once purchased, I would definitely choose a large size if you expect a baby to be born. I really want to recommend this to those struggling to find a housewarming gift. It is a product that satisfies both practicality and interior design at the same time, so the recipient seems to be very satisfied. Since prices fluctuate significantly, I recommend setting an alert before purchasing. I was so disappointed that I missed the lowest price once. If my post was helpful, I would appreciate it if you could press the "Helpful" button. Thank you :)

Sentence (English): I really want to recommend this to those struggling to find a housewarming gift.
Comments (English): Motivation for Purchase: I purchased the LG DIOS Objet dishwasher as a housewarming gift for my sister. Color Selection: My home is 25 pyeong (approx. 82 sq ft), so my kitchen is white-toned and I use beige. However, my sister's kitchen is generally dark brown, so I agonized over the color choice. The 'Nature Manhattan Midnight' color immediately caught my eye. Seeing it installed, I felt I made the right choice. It blends naturally with the kitchen furniture colors without standing out too much, and it acts as a sophisticated accent, so I am completely satisfied! User Review: It creates a much warmer and more sophisticated atmosphere than typical white or stainless steel products, so I am very satisfied with the interior design. My sister loved it so much that she said it was a perfect fit for our home as soon as she saw it. She says she is also quite satisfied with the functional aspects after using it. She says it is much more convenient than hand washing because it cleanly handles a large amount of dishes in one go and dries them cleanly without water stains. She says it is especially useful on busy days or after guests have visited. I also liked that the noise wasn't as loud as I expected, so it wasn't too bothersome even when running it in the evening. I recommend the size. Actually, my sister used a dishwasher in her previous home as well. Since she is a family of four, she initially bought a 10-place setting or 8-place setting model thinking it would be sufficient, but she said she felt it was too small after actually using it. I am a family of three and have been using a 14-place setting model, and I even left a review saying that the 14-place setting is definitely the answer! Of course, it might be a large size for a household of just two adults who don't cook often, but since appliances are used for a long time once purchased, I would definitely choose a large size if you expect a baby to be born. I really want to recommend this to those struggling to find a housewarming gift. It is a product that satisfies both practicality and interior design at the same time, so the recipient seems to be very satisfied. Comments (English): [ A must-have for households with young children ] || ---------------- || Reason for Purchase: The amount of dishwashing increased significantly while raising a baby, so I bought this after looking for a convenient dishwasher. I chose this model because it sits directly on the counter rather than being a built-in type. User Review: First Impression: The size is more compact than I expected, but the design is really clean and doesn't detract from the kitchen interior. After Actual Use: - Saves time by piling up dishes and running them all at once. - The cleaning power is good, so even greasy items are cleaned thoroughly. - The high-temperature sterilization function gives me peace of mind regarding hygiene. - Since it features automatic door opening drying, almost no water remains. Especially while raising a child, bottles and dishes keep piling up, but this one unit handles them all, so my stress has decreased significantly. Thoughts on Use: - The noise isn't as loud as I expected, so it's not a bother even at night. - As it is a 6-place setting, the capacity is perfect for households of 2-3 people, newlyweds, or families with young children. Key Points: From the perspective of a household with a baby, it feels like it solves bottle sterilization, dishwashing, and time saving all at once, so I am highly satisfied. Cons: Compared to large capacity models (12 place settings or more), the amount that fits at once is somewhat limited, so sometimes I have to run it twice when the dishes pile up. Sentence (English): I used to use a 12-place setting, but my back hurt.
Comments (English): [ I bought a Samsung because I thought about it. ] || ---------------- || I used to use a 12-place setting, but my back hurt. So I looked for a 6-place setting that sits on top of the counter. Surprisingly, there aren't many companies selling 6-place models. The ones I looked up were Coupang, MyDee, and Samsung as the main ones. For reference, MyDee is only available on Coupang. And honestly, looking into it, it seemed like all those companies were getting their products from MyDee. So I compared them and bought from Coupang first when they were on sale. However, the power wouldn't turn on as soon as it arrived, and it took over two weeks to get a return. They didn't even take the product away. It just sat there on the sink, taking up space. I was so angry. I thought, "Okay, this won't do. I need to go to a place with good after-sales service," so I finally bought a Samsung. Delivery was fast. Perhaps because they work in teams of two, two people came for the 6-place setting and installed it quickly. They also explained everything well. It's been almost a week since I started using it, and it's so convenient. I don't have to bend my back, and it cleans very well. We are a family of five, but we don't tend to set a huge spread for meals, so when we all eat together, we can run everything in one go. Of course, we hand-wash the large dishes because they take up too much space. You have no idea how convenient this is. It’s really comfortable because you don't have to bend your back. Actually, even when I used the 12-place setting model, there was plenty of space left even after putting in the dishes. People usually recommend the 12-place setting for a family of five, but I guess that varies from household to household. I think I made the right decision buying a Samsung, even if it cost a little more. I know the after-sales service will be great if any problems arise later. Since I consider the after-sales service to be included, I don't even think about the price anymore. I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): I purchased and installed a new dishwasher after moving to a new house.
Comments (English): [ It's the best. ] || ---------------- || I purchased and installed a new dishwasher after moving to a new house. There was already a dishwasher installed in the spot, but they noticed the reinforcing wood supporting the countertop was flimsy and reinforced it for me at no extra cost. Also, the baseboard was missing, so they installed a new one for me as well, free of charge. The dishwasher is very easy to use; regarding the 3-tier tray, I place small items like spoons and forks on the first shelf, plates and bowls on the second, and larger items like pots and inner pans on the third. It fits much more than I expected, and if you utilize the foldable tray, you can fit a huge amount. I look forward to living comfortably in my new home with my new dishwasher.
Comments (Original): [ 최고예요 ] || ---------------- || 새로 이사를 하면서 식기세척기를 새롭게 구매해서 설치하였습니다. 기존에 이미 식기세척기가 설치되어 있던 자리가 있었는데 싱크대 상판을 받쳐주는 보강 목재가 부실하다며 추가비용없이 보강작업도 해주시고, 하부 걸레받이가 어디가고 없었는데, 그것도 추가 비용없이 새걸로 설치해주셨어요 ㅎㅎ식기세척기는 사용하기에 어려움은 전혀 없고 3단 트레이는 위부터 첫번째에는 수저, 포크 등 작은 식기를 올리고,  두번째에는 그릇, 접시류, 세번째에는 냄비나 내솥 등 큰 식기를 넣는데 생각보다 엄청 많이 들어가네요 ㅋㅋㅋ 접히는 식기 받침대 활용하면 엄청 많이 들어가요 ㅎㅎ 새로운 집에서 새로운 식세기로 편하게 잘 지내겠습니다~

Comments (English): [ Mixed bag, hard to recommend. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher has been a bit of a saga, but Costco has been great helping us through it. The first machine we received was missing a letter from the front logo, but it worked well and was quiet. We opted to go with a replacement option instead of taking the $50 offer to keep it. If we would have kept it, we would have tried removing the rest of the logo so it wasn't so obvious the machine came with a defective logo, but we weren't confident we'd be able to remove the rest of the letters ourselves without damaging the front of the dishwasher, so it didn't seem worth the risk. Costco quickly got the replacement ordered and it was delivered later that week. Well, now the replacement machine is here, but it is MUCH louder than the original machine which we noticed right away. You can definitely hear the drain pump/impeller running and it doesn't sound right, especially compared to the first machine. We contacted Costco for a service appointment and they came out yesterday. I wasn't able to make it back in time to meet the technician since he was in and out in less than 10 minutes while I was driving home, but he told my partner that it was perfectly fine and totally normal. He said the first machine must have been a different model that had the drain pump located further back from the front of the machine. What? They're the same machine. both the 624 model. He also didn't take off the base cover plate or pull the dishwasher out to ensure there wasn't any insulation missing etc. Nor did he offer to replace the drain pump/impeller to see if that helped the issue. So now we're here with our 2nd machine that we know is louder than the first machine, but we've been told its totally normal and how it is supposed to be. Needless to say we're now evaluating returning it altogether and going with a different dishwasher company. It's pretty disappointing, we liked the capacity, the usable 3rd rack and having a delay start button on the machine. all of which were why we chose it over a bosch or miele. However, based on the luck of the two machines we've received, replacing with a 3rd kitchenaid seems like russian roulette and who knows what will be wrong with the 3rd machine, maybe it will finally be correct with all the logo letters installed and quiet operation. or maybe it will be worse. based on the track record, it seems it will be worse.

Sentence (English): I'm coming from a low-end Whirlpool dishwasher from the early '00s but man, the Benchmark is a step up!
Comments (English): [ Bosch Benchmark: Bougie, But Buttons bring bummer ] || ---------------- || I'm coming from a low-end Whirlpool dishwasher from the early '00s but man, the Benchmark is a step up! It's chock full of little details that make using a dishwasher better. I love the silverware drawer up top that can hold more pieces of silverware than I ever anticipate needing to wash in one go. The upper rack's adjustable height comes in handy multiple times a week to let me easily clean dishes of varying sizes. And the unit cleans dishes incredibly well. It is easily the nicest dishwasher I have ever owned or used. It loses two full stars though. There are a few little details that are bothersome, like the door hinge feeling stiff and the door itself feeling less sturdy than dishwasher doors used to be. The door works fine but the feel isn't what I expect from something this high end. I also am bummed that there is no dedicated spot to add a smidgen of detergent for pre-wash. I know most people just use pods but prewash can really help and the lack of documentation on the matter leads to a bunch of people on the internet speculating about what you should actually do. But the biggest issue with this dishwasher is that the controls are so mediocre. The buttons to control the dishwasher aren't real buttons, and not only that, the responsiveness is terrible. If you're going to sacrifice real buttons then at least make your screen respond immediately when I press the cheap feeling membrane buttons. For the first few days I struggled to actually figure out how to start a cycle on this, and it continues to be a thing that makes using this dishwasher feel a little worse every time I use it. And it's a regression too; I've seen previous year versions of this dishwasher with real buttons on top. A shame! I love the dishwasher overall but a few bad decisions can really leave a bad taste in your mouth.

Bosch is telling me that the dishwasher is still repairable so I have to wait on the tech - they're not going to replace their faulty equipment. I am blown away by the horrible service I have been getting. Based on service alone, I would never recommend a Bosch appliance to anyone. When you buy a product you're buying more than the product itself; product support is so important for a high dollar item. I asked my repair tech what brand he recommends and he told me to buy the least expensive model that has the features you need because they are all going to break within three years anyways. I know I'm only a sample size of one, but mine didn't even make it one year.All this without mentioning that this dishwasher is not as quiet as everyone says. When it was working, I could definitely tell it was running, even when loaded properly.I'm glad I bought this from Costco because I have a two year warranty instead of the standard Bosch one year. I'd happily buy from Costco again, but never again a Bosch.

Comments (English): [ Shipping, design, and performance are all great. ] || ---------------- || Delivery arrived faster than expected, and the technician visited to install it neatly! Perhaps because of the Bespoke design, the overall look is clean and doesn't clash with the interior, so I was quite satisfied with my first impression. I use it twice a day—day and night—to gather the dishes and run the cycle. Since it is a 6-person capacity, it fits more than enough for a household of 2 to 3 people. I was surprised by how cleanly it cleaned greasy dishes and those with liquid stains, and it definitely feels more convenient as it seems to use less water than hand washing. Above all, the biggest advantage is the reduced dishwashing time. It makes getting ready for bedtime much faster! The noise level is also lower than I expected, so it isn't too bothersome even when running it at night. Overall, it is a product that makes me wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. However, the downside is that it doesn't dry perfectly, so some moisture remains, and it can be a bit awkward to fit large pots or pans in. Overall, rather than being suitable for large families, it is definitely a highly satisfying product for newlyweds, households of 1 to 3 people, and especially for families looking to reduce the burden of dishwashing while raising children. It really feels like the saying that it improves quality of life isn't just a cliché. Highly recommended!

Comments (English): [ Excellent Drying Features! ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) This thing is a beast with the Crystal Dry! I specifically was looking for a dishwasher that dries plastics well, and it more than lives up to that. Unless the plastic containers have wierd edges in them that capture water, it dries them completely, and even if it doesn't, the little water that's left is easy to take care of. As a busy mom of a toddler, I HATED hand drying all the plastics from my older builder grade dishwasher, and I absolutely LOVE this machine! I didn't think I'd use the Wifi capability, but I did download the app and connect it, and found it very helpful, I really like the notifications. The power arms are very sensitive, and if something gets blocked, the dishwasher will continue to run, but will notify me through the app that something is wrong so that I can pause it and remove the blockage - which is usually a toddler bowl that's slipped underneath the bottom rack. Everything comes out fully clean every time, and it uses much less water/electricity than my old dishwasher.

I've been using the Bosch 500 Series dishwasher for a while now, and it's honestly one of the best upgrades I've made to my kitchen. The first thing you notice is how quiet it is. If I had to nitpick, plastics can still come out slightly damp on shorter cycles, but that's pretty typical across most dishwashers. Overall, the Bosch 500 Series is quiet, reliable, and does exactly what you want it to do—clean dishes really well with minimal hassle. Definitely worth the investment.

Comments (English): [ Poorly designed ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) This is my third Bosch dishwasher. The first two were excellent so I assumed the same with this one, but I really regret not shopping around. The first ones I had had a little red light that stayed on when a load was finished and it only turned off when the door was opened. This one has no light and it's impossible to easily know if the dishes inside are clean or dirty. Why on earth would they take that away? But the much bigger problem is the bottom rack configuration. There are huge gaps so that you can't use the bottom rack for anything but plates or pots. Cups or glasses, or ladles etc will fall right through. Again, why did they change this? My previous models were so much more versatile. So disappointed.

Comments (English): [ Not the Kitchenaid dishwashers of a few years ago ] || ---------------- || I always considered Kitchenaid to be a premium brand. I had one long ago, and purchased one for my mother's home in 2019, which is still performing flawlessly. This one has been a huge disappointment. I was going to return it, but they were out of stock and with the holidays approaching, I stuck with it. The middle rack failed immediately, a plastic part snapped off the side extension and if the rack is opened more than halfway, it falls off the rail and has to be painstakingly realigned. I was offered an opportunity to get a replacement rack, but I was unsure if it required a professional to install it because it has a washing arm attached to it. After dealing with the annoyances for a few months, now the dishwasher is making loud groaning and whining noises as it fills, sounding like a demented tuba. Time for a warranty call. It has done an adequate job washing dishes, but comparing it to the one I bought in 2019, the build quality has diminished. The door feels about half the weight. It is more like an economy model than the premium brand it used to be. Not worth the price difference.

Sentence (English): I have installed a few dishwashers over the years.
Comments (English): [ Difficult installation ] || ---------------- || I have installed a few dishwashers over the years. This is the most frustrating one that I have ever had to deal with. The electrical is hidden under the base. You can see it from the picture. When I unboxed it, the wires we tucked up inside and it took a while to locate them. The connections are on the front, and the cord needs to reach to the back. This is just dumb. The water connection was easy to find but difficult to connect to. The fitting is facing the inside. If they would turn it around, it would be easy to make the connection. The kick plate screws on; however, the screws did not fit it. I measured the major diameter and they don't match any standard SAE or metric thread series. I even tried to screw them into my dies, but none fit. I ended up re-tapping the holes for a 10-32 screw and them ordered some, so that I can attach it.If you're purchasing installation, then of course these things are not your problem. Once I finally got it installed, I ran a load. It seems to work OK, although it doesn't dry as well as my old unit, but I can live with that.

Sentence (English): The Finishing Touch to the Kitchen: LG Dishwasher (Dish Dryer) Installation and Real-World Usage Review.
Comments (English): The Finishing Touch to the Kitchen: LG Dishwasher (Dish Dryer) Installation and Real-World Usage Review. I have finally completed the installation of the LG dishwasher, one of the kitchen appliances I put the most effort into while preparing to move into my new apartment. I consulted at the LG Electronics Best Shop in Cheolsan last February and purchased it as a set with the refrigerators; professional technicians installed it perfectly to coincide with my move-in schedule in mid-March. 1. The Pinnacle of Interior: Beautiful silhouette and seamless integration. Installing it as a built-in unit in the base cabinets has elevated the elegance of the kitchen. Perfect Lines: Since I purchased it to match the tone of the refrigerator and kimchi refrigerator, the overall kitchen feels unified, making it look much wider and more luxurious. Minimalist Design: Thanks to its sleek silhouette with no protruding parts, it is a perfect match for the interior of my new home. 2. Convenience Beyond Expectations. After using it myself, I found that there are many features that demonstrate user-friendliness just as much as the design. Smart Storage Space: The interior shelf design is excellent, allowing for the efficient arrangement of dishes and cooking utensils of various sizes. Intuitive Controls: Thanks to an interface that anyone can use easily without complicated procedures, I have been freed from the stress of daily dishwashing. Overwhelming Drying Performance: Seeing the dishes dry and fluffy after washing gives me the feeling that they have been perfectly sterilized, so I use it with complete peace of mind. Professional Installation Service by LG Electronics Technicians. I was also extremely satisfied with the service provided by the technicians who visited in mid-March, timed perfectly with my moving date. Delicate Built-in Installation: They pushed it in very neatly without damaging the cabinets, and even adjusted the leveling precisely, making it look very comfortable. Friendly After-Sales Service Explanation: They kindly explained precautions for first use and how to use the dedicated detergent, which was a great help. Overall Review: I think choosing this as a set with the refrigerator at the Cheolsan branch was the best decision. With easy-to-use features and a beautiful, eye-catching design, spending time in the kitchen has become enjoyable. I highly recommend this to anyone considering new appliances for their new home!
Comments (Original): 주방의 완성, LG 식기세척기(식기건조기) 설치 및 실사용 후기​신축 아파트 입주를 준비하며 가장 공들였던 주방 가전 중 하나인 LG 식기세척기 설치를 드디어 마쳤습니다. 지난 2월 LG전자 베스트샵 철산점에서 상담받고 냉장고들과 세트로 구매했는데, 3월 중순 입주 일정에 맞춰 전문 기사님들이 완벽하게 설치해 주셨네요.​1. 인테리어의 정점: 예쁜 실루엣과 일체감​주방 하부장에 빌트인으로 설치하고 나니 주방의 품격이 달라졌습니다.​완벽한 라인: 냉장고, 김치냉장고와 톤을 맞춰 구매했더니 주방 전체에 통일감이 생겨 훨씬 넓고 고급스러워 보입니다.​미니멀한 디자인: 튀어나온 곳 없이 매끈하게 떨어지는 실루엣 덕분에 새 집 인테리어와 찰떡궁합이에요.​2. 기대 이상의 사용 편의성​직접 사용해 보니 디자인만큼이나 사용자 배려가 돋보이는 기능들이 많습니다.​스마트한 수납 공간: 다양한 크기의 식기와 조리 도구를 효율적으로 배치할 수 있도록 내부 선반 설계가 아주 잘 되어 있습니다.​직관적인 조작부: 복잡한 과정 없이 누구나 쉽게 사용할 수 있는 인터페이스 덕분에 매일 설거지 스트레스에서 해방되었습니다.​압도적인 건조 성능: 세척 후 뽀송뽀송하게 건조된 그릇을 보면 살균까지 완벽하게 된 기분이라 정말 안심하고 사용 중입니다.​3. LG전자 기사님의 전문적인 설치 서비스​3월 중순, 이사 날짜에 맞춰 방문해 주신 기사님들의 서비스도 대만족이었습니다.​섬세한 빌트인 작업: 가구장 손상 없이 아주 깔끔하게 밀어 넣어 주셨고, 수평까지 세밀하게 맞춰주셔서 보기에도 아주 편안합니다.​친절한 사후 관리 설명: 첫 사용 시 주의사항과 전용 세제 활용법 등을 친절하게 알려주셔서 큰 도움이 되었습니다.​총평:철산점에서 냉장고와 함께 세트로 선택한 것이 최고의 결정이었던 것 같습니다. 사용이 용이한 기능과 눈을 사로잡는 예쁜 디자인까지, 주방에 머무는 시간이 즐거워졌네요. 입주 가전 고민하시는 분들께 강력 추천합니다!

Comments (Original): 주방의 완성, LG 식기세척기(식기건조기) 설치 및 실사용 후기​신축 아파트 입주를 준비하며 가장 공들였던 주방 가전 중 하나인 LG 식기세척기 설치를 드디어 마쳤습니다. 지난 2월 LG전자 베스트샵 철산점에서 상담받고 냉장고들과 세트로 구매했는데, 3월 중순 입주 일정에 맞춰 전문 기사님들이 완벽하게 설치해 주셨네요.​1. 인테리어의 정점: 예쁜 실루엣과 일체감​주방 하부장에 빌트인으로 설치하고 나니 주방의 품격이 달라졌습니다.​완벽한 라인: 냉장고, 김치냉장고와 톤을 맞춰 구매했더니 주방 전체에 통일감이 생겨 훨씬 넓고 고급스러워 보입니다.​미니멀한 디자인: 튀어나온 곳 없이 매끈하게 떨어지는 실루엣 덕분에 새 집 인테리어와 찰떡궁합이에요.​2. 기대 이상의 사용 편의성​직접 사용해 보니 디자인만큼이나 사용자 배려가 돋보이는 기능들이 많습니다.​스마트한 수납 공간: 다양한 크기의 식기와 조리 도구를 효율적으로 배치할 수 있도록 내부 선반 설계가 아주 잘 되어 있습니다.​직관적인 조작부: 복잡한 과정 없이 누구나 쉽게 사용할 수 있는 인터페이스 덕분에 매일 설거지 스트레스에서 해방되었습니다.​압도적인 건조 성능: 세척 후 뽀송뽀송하게 건조된 그릇을 보면 살균까지 완벽하게 된 기분이라 정말 안심하고 사용 중입니다.​3. LG전자 기사님의 전문적인 설치 서비스​3월 중순, 이사 날짜에 맞춰 방문해 주신 기사님들의 서비스도 대만족이었습니다.​섬세한 빌트인 작업: 가구장 손상 없이 아주 깔끔하게 밀어 넣어 주셨고, 수평까지 세밀하게 맞춰주셔서 보기에도 아주 편안합니다.​친절한 사후 관리 설명: 첫 사용 시 주의사항과 전용 세제 활용법 등을 친절하게 알려주셔서 큰 도움이 되었습니다.​총평:철산점에서 냉장고와 함께 세트로 선택한 것이 최고의 결정이었던 것 같습니다. 사용이 용이한 기능과 눈을 사로잡는 예쁜 디자인까지, 주방에 머무는 시간이 즐거워졌네요. 입주 가전 고민하시는 분들께 강력 추천합니다!

Comments (English): The Finishing Touch to the Kitchen: LG Dishwasher (Dish Dryer) Installation and Real-World Usage Review. I have finally completed the installation of the LG dishwasher, one of the kitchen appliances I put the most effort into while preparing to move into my new apartment. I consulted at the LG Electronics Best Shop in Cheolsan last February and purchased it as a set with the refrigerators; professional technicians installed it perfectly to coincide with my move-in schedule in mid-March. 1. The Pinnacle of Interior: Beautiful silhouette and seamless integration. Installing it as a built-in unit in the base cabinets has elevated the elegance of the kitchen. Perfect Lines: Since I purchased it to match the tone of the refrigerator and kimchi refrigerator, the overall kitchen feels unified, making it look much wider and more luxurious. Minimalist Design: Thanks to its sleek silhouette with no protruding parts, it is a perfect match for the interior of my new home. 2. Convenience Beyond Expectations. After using it myself, I found that there are many features that demonstrate user-friendliness just as much as the design. Smart Storage Space: The interior shelf design is excellent, allowing for the efficient arrangement of dishes and cooking utensils of various sizes. Intuitive Controls: Thanks to an interface that anyone can use easily without complicated procedures, I have been freed from the stress of daily dishwashing. Overwhelming Drying Performance: Seeing the dishes dry and fluffy after washing gives me the feeling that they have been perfectly sterilized, so I use it with complete peace of mind. Professional Installation Service by LG Electronics Technicians. I was also extremely satisfied with the service provided by the technicians who visited in mid-March, timed perfectly with my moving date. Delicate Built-in Installation: They pushed it in very neatly without damaging the cabinets, and even adjusted the leveling precisely, making it look very comfortable. Friendly After-Sales Service Explanation: They kindly explained precautions for first use and how to use the dedicated detergent, which was a great help. Overall Review: I think choosing this as a set with the refrigerator at the Cheolsan branch was the best decision. With easy-to-use features and a beautiful, eye-catching design, spending time in the kitchen has become enjoyable. I highly recommend this to anyone considering new appliances for their new home!

Comments (English): The Finishing Touch to the Kitchen: LG Dishwasher (Dish Dryer) Installation and Real-World Usage Review. I have finally completed the installation of the LG dishwasher, one of the kitchen appliances I put the most effort into while preparing to move into my new apartment. I consulted at the LG Electronics Best Shop in Cheolsan last February and purchased it as a set with the refrigerators; professional technicians installed it perfectly to coincide with my move-in schedule in mid-March. 1. The Pinnacle of Interior: Beautiful silhouette and seamless integration. Installing it as a built-in unit in the base cabinets has elevated the elegance of the kitchen. Perfect Lines: Since I purchased it to match the tone of the refrigerator and kimchi refrigerator, the overall kitchen feels unified, making it look much wider and more luxurious. Minimalist Design: Thanks to its sleek silhouette with no protruding parts, it is a perfect match for the interior of my new home. 2. Convenience Beyond Expectations. After using it myself, I found that there are many features that demonstrate user-friendliness just as much as the design. Smart Storage Space: The interior shelf design is excellent, allowing for the efficient arrangement of dishes and cooking utensils of various sizes. Intuitive Controls: Thanks to an interface that anyone can use easily without complicated procedures, I have been freed from the stress of daily dishwashing. Overwhelming Drying Performance: Seeing the dishes dry and fluffy after washing gives me the feeling that they have been perfectly sterilized, so I use it with complete peace of mind. Professional Installation Service by LG Electronics Technicians. I was also extremely satisfied with the service provided by the technicians who visited in mid-March, timed perfectly with my moving date. Delicate Built-in Installation: They pushed it in very neatly without damaging the cabinets, and even adjusted the leveling precisely, making it look very comfortable. Friendly After-Sales Service Explanation: They kindly explained precautions for first use and how to use the dedicated detergent, which was a great help. Overall Review: I think choosing this as a set with the refrigerator at the Cheolsan branch was the best decision. With easy-to-use features and a beautiful, eye-catching design, spending time in the kitchen has become enjoyable. I highly recommend this to anyone considering new appliances for their new home!

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for a little over a month now, so this is not a long term review.
Comments (English): I've had this dishwasher for a little over a month now, so this is not a long term review. I replaced a 13 year old Kenmore dishwasher model with this unit, and I am happy so far. It has more settings than the old Kenmore model and completes cycles cleaner and faster. It allows for every setting I can think of needing- some may need a fine china setting (not available on this), but i would probably hand wash that type stuff anyway. The Steam sanitizer, Wash temp boost and quick rinse are nice options. The Dry boost (with two settings) gets really hot, I haven't even tried the second dry boost setting yet- not sure if this gets interior hotter, or just runs heat cycle a little longer. Only problem I had - the 2 screws that tighten the floor kick plate (front) bottom floor didn't fit (too large), so I had to purchase smaller machine type screws to tighten this bottom front floor panel. Not sure if this will apply to all, or just had the incorrect screw size in my delivery package.

Sentence (English): We've had our Samsung Bespoke dishwasher for about four months now and it's working very nicely for us.
Comments (English): [ A quite quality dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We've had our Samsung Bespoke dishwasher for about four months now and it's working very nicely for us. This replaced a Bosch 300 dishwasher that our former owner got probably not too long ago, maybe about 6 years. Its motor failed to engage with the bottom propeller and wasnt cleaning dishes.​This dishwasher is very quite. You can barely tell it's even running. There is a 38 Dba one from Samsung, but honestly this 42 Dba is more than enough even id you are sensitive to noise. The dishes come out very clean. Sentence (English): I purchased this Bosch dishwasher through Costco, expecting both quality and strong customer support.
Comments (English): [ Very disappointed – unreliable product and frustra ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch dishwasher through Costco, expecting both quality and strong customer support. Unfortunately, my experience has been extremely disappointing.From the beginning, the dishwasher had occasional issues. Since it worked most of the time, I didn't go through the hassle of replacing it within the 90-day window (especially because replacing a dishwasher requires hiring a plumber to disconnect and install a new one).After about 6.5 months, the unit completely stopped working.When I contacted Costco technical support , I was surprised to learn that the warranty is handled entirely through Bosch. Costco confirmed they cannot intervene and must follow Bosch's process.Bosch scheduled a technician visit 1.5 weeks later, leaving me without a dishwasher and washing everything by hand. When the technician finally arrived, after about an hour of inspection, he determined that three major parts needed replacement - on a nearly new appliance! Even worse, the estimated time for the parts is over one month :0.This means I could be without a working dishwasher for two months or more, and even then there is no guarantee it will be fixed. The technician explained that only after multiple service visits might Bosch consider a replacement—but even that is not guaranteed.I contacted Costco again and spoke with a manager, Magen, from technical support. I explained that waiting months for repairs on a nearly new dishwasher is not reasonable and that I expected a replacement. However, she told me that this is Bosch's decision and that Costco cannot do anything beyond sending a request email and following their process. I found this very frustrating and disappointing, as I expected more support from Costco in this situation.I buy all my appliances from Costco and have always trusted their customer support - even though I've never needed to use it before. It's very disappointing to find out that when I actually need help, I don't have Costco backing me. The main reason I shop there is because I believed they would stand behind their products and help in situations like this.A warranty should provide timely and reasonable solutions, not require customers to wait months while repeatedly scheduling repairs.At this point, I'm very disappointed in both the product quality and the lack of support. I expected better from both Bosch and Costco.

Sentence (English): I don't usually write reviews, but this experience deserves one.
Comments (English): [ Broke in 11 Months, Warranty Was a Nightmare! ] || ---------------- || I don't usually write reviews, but this experience deserves one. Our Bosch dishwasher failed completely after just 11 months, and it's now totally unresponsive. For something at this price point, that's already hard to justify, and it only went downhill from there. We had a Bosch technician out three separate times, and each visit meant waiting about a week for parts, then another two weeks just to get him back out. This dragged on for over two months. In the end, he admitted there was nothing more he could do and said these units are largely made with cheap plastic components that they don't usually keep in stock, which honestly explains a lot. At the same time, dealing with Bosch warranty support was even more frustrating. I had registered the product within 30 days of purchase and already uploaded my Costco receipt as part of the process, then I provided it again when asked as part of this process. They refused to accept the invoice directly from Costco's site and told me I needed to go back to Costco for “proof of purchase.” When I sent the exact proof of purchase Costco emailed me, they claimed it looked like something I created in Word and implied I was trying to pass off a forgery. That was honestly the most insulting part of this whole process. Even when it worked, the dishwasher was average at best, nowhere near worth the premium price. The bigger issue is the complete lack of respect for your time. Between the delays, the runaround, and the way this was handled, this was easily one of the most frustrating product experiences I've had. Bosch has lost a customer for life. I would strongly recommend staying away.

Sentence (English): This is the first LG Dios dishwasher I've ever purchased!
Comments (English): This is the first LG Dios dishwasher I've ever purchased! I was mistaken in thinking that you needed to budget around one or two million won for a dishwasher. I asked friends and acquaintances, and they agreed that its basic performance alone makes it well worth the price, so I decided to buy it. @ Delivery. A professional delivered it right on time and on the scheduled date. They were kind and installed it meticulously. @ Appearance. The clean beige tone blended perfectly with my kitchen base cabinets without looking out of place. With the doors closed, it looked the epitome of neatness! @ Usage and Performance. 1. Although a 14-place setting model has recently been released, the size is similar to the 12-place setting, and I think the 12-place setting is sufficient for a family of four, depending on how you arrange the dishes. I usually soak dishes and do them all at once, so this is exactly the appliance I need. 2. The spacious interior allows for the storage of large plates, frying pans, and pots. If you just pre-wash them once before putting them in, even greasy dishes become shiny, so the cleaning power is excellent. 3. Since it was my first time using one, the noise was loud enough to let me know that dishes were being washed, but I got used to it because there is no vibration or movement like with a washing machine. It has an automatic door opening function after washing, so if I run it once in the evening, most of the dishes are dry by morning. I did have to dry a few items separately, though. There is a cutlery holder, and since you can just shove the cutlery in, I don't spend much time putting it away. *** I chose the 12-place setting model instead of the premium hot air drying feature, but I don't think there is any other dishwasher model with this kind of value for money for actual use. I used to have some distrust in online products, but I am 100% satisfied. It is the most basic model, but it is perfect because it stays true to the basics, and if you are stressed about washing dishes, it seems to completely solve that problem. This is a product I bought with my own money, and I recommend it!

This is a product I bought with my own money, and I recommend it!

Sentence (English): Reason for Purchase: As my children grew, their food intake increased, and with the addition of snacks, the dishes just kept piling up endlessly.
Comments (English): [ Escape the Dishwashing Hell: Parenting Essentials ] || ---------------- || Reason for Purchase: As my children grew, their food intake increased, and with the addition of snacks, the dishes just kept piling up endlessly. I was constantly wrestling with the chores while wearing rubber gloves, which left me with insufficient time to play with the kids and caused my wrists to ache, so I finally made a decision. The dishwasher I used before had a small capacity; it would be completely full with just one pot inside. I decided that bigger was the answer this time, so I looked into a 14-place setting model. I particularly loved the LG Dios Objet Collection because its design is so beautiful that I didn't have to worry about ruining the kitchen interior. Since it is a built-in model that fits perfectly and looks sleek, I chose it without hesitation. My husband also promised to free us from this dishwashing hell, so I ordered it with high expectations. Review: After installing and using it, it is truly a whole new world. First off, perhaps because it is a 14-place setting, the interior space is incredibly spacious, so stockpots and large frying pans fit right in. Before, I had to carefully stack dishes like playing Tetris, but now I can just roughly place them down and there is still plenty of space left, making it so convenient. And seeing the door automatically open slightly and the steam escape with a whoosh after the wash was finished was incredibly satisfying. I am truly satisfied that I can take out and use fresh, dry dishes the next morning without worrying about wet ones. The noise level is also much quieter than I expected, so I can leave it running late at night and still get a good night's sleep. Product Features: The biggest advantage of this product is the Tornado Wash Wing. Powerful water jets spray up, down, left, and right to reach every corner, washing away even stubborn food residue cleanly. The 100° True Steam function is a must-have for households with children; it sterilizes baby bottles and tableware with high-temperature steam, giving me peace of mind knowing I don't have to worry about harmful bacteria. Additionally, thanks to the Smart Shelf System, the shelves can be adjusted to fit different heights of dishes, allowing for efficient storage. The inclusion of a water softener, ensuring clean dishes without water stains, is another example of LG's thoughtful attention to detail. It is also energy-efficient, so the electricity bill is relatively low even if I run it every day, making it economical as well. Conclusion: With less kitchen work, I definitely feel less stressed about childcare and have gained some free time to myself, which has dramatically improved my quality of life. You have no idea how much happiness it brings to be able to read an extra book to the kids during dishwashing time. From the design to the performance, nothing is lacking, so I keep praising it endlessly to the moms around me. If you are considering buying a dishwasher, I highly recommend the 14-place setting Objet Collection; as they say, "the bigger, the better." You won't regret your choice.

Sentence (English): This is the worst dishwasher I've ever had the displeasure of using.
Comments (English): [ Learn from my mistake and skip this dishwasher!  ] || ---------------- || This is the worst dishwasher I've ever had the displeasure of using. I bought for the name and the noise level. While it is quiet and I appreciated that. This dishwasher was confusing to use. It didn't dry anything. My dishes came out soaked. All the pegs on the bottom rack are slanted so it makes it hard to fit things like Stanley's/tumblers, pots and strainers, and the large mason jars I use for food storage. The small little silverware basket it comes with can only be put in one spot on either side of the bottom rack but it makes it hard to organize the dishes but I'm used to a long silverware rack on the side. It's small on the inside, I could hardly fit a sink load of dishes in it, especially if I had to wash multiple large pots and pans. Sometimes I was running it 2-3 times a day to stay up on my dishes- I do have 2 teenaged boys who eat several times a day. And the middle rack has this little shelf on the front of it where the dish pod drops into during the wash cycle, which would be fine but it's that much less of space in the middle rack to use. Personal preference I don't like the large silverware 3rd rack, I like to be able to use the 3rd rack for bigger items if needed but there's not much clearance to do that. I was hoping to like it since I hated the silverware basket but I just didn't. And last thing I have to say is the way my dishwasher is located in my kitchen, I would keep accidentally bumping the buttons when standing next to it with the door open- which I have to as that's where my sink is and the only place I can stand or where the dishwasher could be. The buttons are so sensitive that just my leg touching one would start it while the door was open while I was loading it. I'm sure that's not good for it. I have no pros to this dishwasher. Would never consider buying it again. I returned to Costco after a month of hating it. Return was very easy, the installers took this one and installed the Kitchen Aid I got and I'm very happy so far.

All the pegs on the bottom rack are slanted so it makes it hard to fit things like Stanley’s/tumblers, pots and strainers, and the large mason jars I use for food storage. The small little silverware basket it comes with can only be put in one spot on either side of the bottom rack but it makes it hard to organize the dishes but I’m used to a long silverware rack on the side. It’s small on the inside, I could hardly fit a sink load of dishes in it, especially if I had to wash multiple large pots and pans. Sometimes I was running it 2-3 times a day to stay up on my dishes- I do have 2 teenaged boys who eat several times a day. And the middle rack has this little shelf on the front of it where the dish pod drops into during the wash cycle, which would be fine but it’s that much less of space in the middle rack to use. Personal preference I don’t like the large silverware 3rd rack, I like to be able to use the 3rd rack for bigger items if needed but there’s not much clearance to do that. I was hoping to like it since I hated the silverware basket but I just didn’t. And last thing I have to say is the way my dishwasher is located in my kitchen, I would keep accidentally bumping the buttons when standing next to it with the door open- which I have to as that’s where my sink is and the only place I can stand or where the dishwasher could be. The buttons are so sensitive that just my leg touching one would start it while the door was open while I was loading it.. I’m sure that’s not good for it. I have no pros to this dishwasher. Would never consider buying it again. I returned to Costco after a month of hating it. Return was very easy, the installers took this one and installed the Kitchen Aid I got and I’m very happy so far.

Sentence (English): I am leaving this review because the review of the Samsung.com Customer Center is more important than the review of this product.
Comments (English): I am leaving this review because the review of the Samsung.com Customer Center is more important than the review of this product. I ordered this along with a refrigerator and freezer on February 1st and requested delivery for March 5th to coincide with my moving day. However, since I received no contact until two days prior, I called the customer center on the morning of March 3rd to ask if there was a delivery delay or if the shipment would actually be delivered. The representative promised to contact me after checking, but I received no response by that afternoon. I called again, but the representative did not reply once more. Then, my three calls the following morning were ignored again with no response. That afternoon, after numerous attempts, I finally managed to reach them, but they only said they would contact me after checking again and still did not reply. If I had received notification about the delivery delay on the date I inquired, I could have changed my order to a product available for immediate delivery and had it installed on my desired date. However, because I received no notification whatsoever, I am forced to discard my precious food. On the evening of the 5th, a person claiming to be a manager contacted me and stated that no compensation was possible. As if to make a show of doing me a favor, they offered to sell me the unit at the original purchase price, even though a different color is more expensive and installation is possible in two days. I have no idea what you're talking about. We had already had to throw away all the food waste, and I absolutely cannot understand how they handled business by claiming they couldn't even notify us of the delivery delay until the morning of the day before. How on earth are you managing Samsung's customer center and logistics center? Do you outsource everything so that the headquarters doesn't handle quality control? It is shocking that there is absolutely no customer compensation system and they fail to provide even basic responses. This product arrived on the date I requested, and I am satisfied with the product itself. Although the door panel wasn't properly aligned during installation, they came back and kindly corrected it for me.
Comments (Original): 이 제품에 대한 리뷰보다는 삼성닷컴 고객센터에 대한 리뷰가 더 중요해서 남깁니다. 냉장냉동고랑 같이 2.1에 주문했고 배송요청일 이사날에 맞춰 3.5로 지정했는데, 2일 전까지 아무 연락이 없어서 고객센터에 전화해서 배송지연인지 배송되는지 3.3오전에 확인요청 드렸습니다. 상담사는 확인 후 연락 주기로 하고 그 날 오후까지 연락이 없었고, 다시 전화했지만 또 상담사는 회신을 주지 않았습니다. 그리고 그 다음 날 오전 3번에 걸친 제 전회도 또 다시 씹히고 회신은 없었고 그 날 오후 수차례의 전화 끝에 겨우 연락이 닿았지만 또 다시 확인 후 연락주겠다는 말만 하고 또 다시 회신이 없었습니다.배송지연이라는 안내만 제가 문의한 날짜에 받았으면 바로 배송되는 제품으로 변경 후 주문하면 원히는 날짜에 설치가 가능한데, 어떠한 안내도 받을 수 없어서 소중한 음식들을 폐기해야 함에도 5일 저녁에 매니저라는 사람이 연락와서는 어떠한 보상도 불가능하고 마치 생색내듯이 다른 색상이 더 비싼데 2일 뒤에 설치 가능한데 원래 구입한 가격에 주겠다고 합니다. 말인지 방구인지. 이미 음식물은 다 폐기해야만 했고 “배송지연” 안내가 하루 전 오전까지도 어려운지 도저히 이해가 안 되는 업무처리방식입니다.삼성 고객센터랑 물류센터 관리를 도대체 어떻게 하는겁니까. 모든 걸 외주 줘서 본사에서 품질관리라는 걸 안 합니까. 고객보상 시스템도 전혀 없고 기본적인 회신 응대도 안 되다니 충격입니다. 이 제품은 배송 원하는 날짜에 왔고 제품도 만족합니다. 설치 시 도어패널 좌우대칭을 잘 안 맞춰주었지만 다시 오셔서 친절하게 수정해주었습니다.

Sentence (English): After much deliberation about which dishwasher to buy, I finally installed the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting model and have been using it for about a month.
Comments (English): After much deliberation about which dishwasher to buy, I finally installed the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting model and have been using it for about a month. I purchased it to reduce dishwashing stress while moving, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First off, perhaps because it is a 14-place setting model, quite a lot of dishes fit in at once, so the most convenient thing was being able to handle all the dishes from dinner in one go. Most pots and pans fit in as well, so I rarely have to wash them by hand. Thanks to the steam cleaning function, even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly, and the fact that it includes sterilization drying in one go is definitely convenient. Thanks to the hot air drying, there is almost no water left behind, so the dishes are ready to be taken out and used immediately. Still, considering the time and stress I used to spend on dishwashing, it is a level that is well worth it, and the electricity and water efficiency is decent, so overall, I am very satisfied. I would rate it about 4.7 to 4.8 out of 5, and it is definitely a product I can recommend to those who cook frequently at home or find washing dishes a hassle.
